title: Tomodachi Game
source: Tomodachi Game manga by Mikoto Yamaguchi and Yuki Sato (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: High-school student Yuuichi Katagiri and his four close friends are kidnapped into the 'Tomodachi Game' to pay off a 20 million yen debt one of them supposedly owes. The games test friendship through lies, votes and betrayal. Yuuichi, who says friends matter more than money, turns out to be a ruthless strategist willing to play dirty to protect them and to break the game's organisers. A twisty psychological death-game story about trust.
power_system: No powers. The games are run by an organisation with a mascot host (Manabu-kun); debts, votes and secrets are the weapons.
